title: ErrorDefinition
description:
One error code's definition: the situation it names, and for each probable
cause, the remediations that answer it. The code is
`<component type>-<component name>-<number>` on the wire and a moniker in
source (`ErrChromeNotRunning`). Each remediation carries an optional
`action` a component can run, and an `approvalPolicy` that says whether
running it needs the person's approval: `required` asks first, `not_required`
runs on its own and tells the person it did, `inherit` (or absent) resolves
through the platform, workspace and profile setting. A remediation with no
`action` is something only a person can do, and carries no policy.
The registry's own check (engine/blowhorn/error_codes.py) refuses what this
construct cannot say with the keywords the engine's subset validator enforces:
an `approvalPolicy` without an `action`, and an empty causes or remediations
list. Numbers are per component and never reused.
